title: Budgeting
text: Create a budget by recording income, listing essential expenses such as rent and transport, setting category limits, and reviewing actual spending each month.

title: Saving money
text: Choose an affordable savings contribution after reviewing essential costs. Set a named goal and track contributions regularly.

title: Emergency funds
text: An emergency fund is money set aside for unexpected essential costs or interrupted income. Start with a small achievable target and build toward several months of essential expenses.

title: Managing expenses
text: To reduce unnecessary spending, review categories, compare recurring bills, plan grocery shopping, and pause purchases you do not need.

title: Financial planning
text: List short and long term goals, estimate their costs, choose target dates, and review progress when income or expenses change.

title: Needs versus wants
text: Needs support essential living, such as housing, groceries and transport to work. Wants improve comfort or enjoyment, such as entertainment. Context matters.

title: Understanding income
text: Income is money received from salary, freelance work or other sources. In Jamaica, budget using the take-home Jamaican dollar amount you actually receive.

title: Managing debt
text: List balances, interest costs and minimum payments. Plan required payments first and compare strategies for paying extra. Contact the lender if payments become difficult.

title: Financial habits
text: Record transactions consistently, review your budget weekly and set realistic savings goals. Small regular actions make records more useful.
